title: docs: CONTRIBUTING_<LANG> fixes
body:
The CONTRIBUTING_GO.md and CONTRIBUTING_RUST.md files were removed in 8c8acf4, but they were still linked in the README.

This PR recreates the Golang file and links it to the project wide file.

comments.body: Or we can just remove the Golang file as well if you don't like it :D

Yeah, I figured dropping the file would make more sense. On a related note, since the other files (security, coc, contributing) also point upstream, would you be in favor of replacing those with direct links as well? I can see there may be some value in keeping them for the cases where someone browses the file tree before getting to the README, but I'm indifferent either way.

@Luap99

> I can see there may be some value in keeping them for the cases where someone browses the file tree before getting to the README, but I'm indifferent either way.

Yes they must be kept, SECURITY.md, CONTRIBUTING.md are AFAIK both files github detects and links them as part of their UI, i.e. when opening a PR it tells new users to read CONTRIBUTING.md and if they reports security issues it shows them SECURITY.md. So we want to keep that working even if the files then just link elsewhere

Oh and the CoC file might be a CNCF requirement, not sure if they actually require the file to exists as top level file but we must follow the CNCF Code of Conduct everywhere on all our repos so better to have it here.
